home.societyPromise: Once the day's questions have responses, this reads the balance back to you in a sentence — which way {{region}} is leaning, and how thin the middle is.
home.mediaSurgePromise: When a story starts running well above its usual volume, it shows up here first — so you can take a position before the coverage peaks.
home.participationPromise: Every position taken feeds the counts here. It is the fastest way to see whether a question is actually live or already settled.
home.whereRegionSits: Where {{region}} sits right now, and where you sit inside it.

home.topicLinePromise: Every topic you answer in gets a line here: your position, the regional average, and the distance between them. Three answers is enough for the first line to appear.
home.stanceProfilePromise: A plain-language read of how you answer — how strongly you commit, and how widely you range across topics.
home.divergentTopicPromise: The topic where you sit furthest from everyone else — usually the most interesting thing the platform can tell you about yourself.

pulse.STABLE_s1: Most major topics are showing limited directional change right now, including {{t1}} and {{t2}}.
pulse.STABLE_s2: Stance signals look relatively steady, with few rapid shifts over the last 24 hours.
pulse.REAWAKENING_s1: Conversation is reactivating around {{t1}} and {{t2}}, with renewed stance activity after a quieter period.
pulse.REAWAKENING_s2: Early signals suggest engagement is returning, and positions are still forming.
pulse.REAWAKENING_s2t3: Early signals suggest engagement is returning, and positions are still forming — especially on {{t3}}.
pulse.POLARIZING_s1: Stance signals are diverging most sharply on {{t1}} and {{t2}}, with regional alignment beginning to split.
pulse.POLARIZING_s2: Engagement remains strong, and polarization cues are becoming more visible.
pulse.POLARIZING_s2t3: Engagement remains strong, and polarization cues are becoming more visible — particularly around {{t3}}.
pulse.ACCELERATING_s1: Multiple topics are shifting at once — led by {{t1}} and {{t2}} — with noticeable stance movement over the past 48 hours.
pulse.ACCELERATING_s2: Momentum is broad rather than isolated, with rapid re-evaluation across several topics.
pulse.ACCELERATING_s2t3: Momentum is broad rather than isolated, and {{t3}} is also seeing rapid re-evaluation.
pulse.FOCUSED_s1: Movement is concentrated around {{t1}} and {{t2}}, where stance intensity is changing faster than most other topics.
pulse.FOCUSED_s2: Outside of those, signals look steadier.
pulse.FOCUSED_s2t3: Outside of those, signals look steadier — though {{t3}} is beginning to pick up.
